## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (telemetry.enabled master switch — correct, well-covered; two modest new test-coverage suggestions, none merge-gating)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #2035: Add a telemetry.enabled master config key — criteria from issue body; scope not-established (no workpad compared this run). Requirement-based checklist items are included in the verification results below.
This PR has no workpad criteria to use, so the issue body's `## Acceptance Criteria` section supplied them.

Against the shipped code, every acceptance criterion is satisfied:
- AC1 (each of five enrolled sub-keys inherits `false` on the miss path) — assertions present.
- AC2 (explicit sub-key wins in both directions) — structurally guaranteed (an explicit boolean yields non-empty stdout and never reaches `emit_default_or_fail`) and tested.
- AC3 (seven master-key shapes; only JSON boolean `false` disables via a JSON-type read, `is False` not `== False`) — `scripts/telemetry-master-off.py` reads the JSON type; number `0`/string `"false"`/`null`/wrong-typed/corrupt all stay ON; tested.
- AC4 (`--persist` and `collect-staged-telemetry.sh` skip under master-off) — real bare-remote git fixtures with positive controls.
- AC5 (master-absent / unreadable behaves as before, fail-safe to ON, never aborts) — corrupt-config positive control on `--persist`.
- AC6 (non-enrolled key byte-identical, superseded breadcrumb preserved) — master check runs after `probe_superseded_key`, only for the enrolled `case`; tested.
- AC7 (schema `telemetry.enabled` boolean default true, runtime-read, only-JSON-false, each sub-key description names inheritance; example carries key) — present.
- AC8 (no `skills/**` or `.github/workflows/**` differs) — confirmed absent from the diff.

## Verification Checklist Results
Checklist not separately generated this run (fix-loop iteration 3, focused on new-defect variance recovery over an already-verified change); Phase-3 agents verified the load-bearing claims against HEAD directly. No FAIL, no INCONCLUSIVE.

## Code Review Findings

### 🟠 Important / Major
1. Enrolled-key + no-default call under master-off is untested. In `scripts/config-get.sh`, `emit_default_or_fail` runs `telemetry_master_disables_for` before the `has_default` check, so an enrolled key on the miss path with `telemetry.enabled=false` prints `false` and exits 0 even with no caller default — while a non-enrolled no-default miss exits 1. The exit-code residual block exercises this branch only with the non-enrolled `nonexistent.key`; no assertion pins the enrolled-key-no-default-under-master-off shape, so a refactor moving the master block below `has_default` would regress it silently (every existing enrolled assertion passes a `true` default and would still pass). One assertion (enrolled key, no default, `m-false.json`, expect stdout `false` + exit 0) locks it. (raised by 1/5 agents) [suspected over-grade: shape 3 — single-source from pr-test-analyzer, no corroboration and no Phase-2 FAIL; observable impact is a missing test, milder than the Important label]

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. `scripts/collect-staged-telemetry.sh` has no corrupt/unreadable-config fail-safe-ON assertion, asymmetric with the `--persist` path (which has `m-corrupt.json` coverage). The guard wiring is a separate call site; a symmetric corrupt-config case would prove its `&&`-chain fails safe to ON. Low cost. (raised by 1/5 agents)
2. `scripts/collect-staged-telemetry.sh` master-off guard fires before the `rm -rf "$DEST"` / `mkdir -p "$DEST"` reset, so under master-off a `$DEST` left populated by a prior run is neither cleared nor refreshed. Harmless: the function prints nothing on this path, so the caller's "something to upload" signal is empty and the stale tree is never uploaded. Noted for completeness. (raised by 1/5 agents)

over-grade annotation: finding flagged (Important test-gap, shape 3 advisory).
truthfulness sweep: no finding promoted.
intra-diff contradiction scan: no contradiction found.

## Verdict Criteria
Default `verdict_severity_threshold` = `critical`. No verification FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; no self-contradicting-diff finding (all diff-added prose and comments verified truthful against HEAD); no finding at or above `critical`. Only findings below the threshold present → APPROVE with notes. The three new findings are non-gating test-coverage / cosmetic suggestions a fix-loop may optionally address; none blocks merge.

Note: `requesting-code-review` reported `EXTENSION-STATUS: loaded-empty resolved-root=unset` (no consumer review extension content) — expected on this repo.
